_doc: Money (T-0054, D29). Amounts are euro cents. player_start: the new-game player's cash and bank (backgrounds change it in T-0075). resident_start: [min, max] for generated residents, drawn in whole euros from the "money" stream. Free will (T-0055): each euro of a price costs price_cost_per_euro points of score, times low_money_factor when the person holds less than low_money. Groceries (T-0057): a fridge holds fridge_capacity portions; new households start with start_groceries [min, max]; free will goes shopping (with restock_bonus) when the stock is below restock_below, and eats out when hunger is below hungry_below with fewer than 2 portions at home. Jobs (T-0058): a new game's player starts in player_job ("" = none); people of retirement_age and over are retired. Pay and performance (T-0061): wages earned per shift are paid on payday (weekday 0 = Monday, hour); after each shift performance (0..100, starting at 50) gains shift_done (+ good_mood in a good mood), loses per_5_minutes_late, left_early (leaving more than 30 minutes early) or missed; at promote_at after promote_after_shifts shifts at a level they are promoted (performance then after_promotion); below warn_below they get a warning, given again only after performance has risen above warning_clears_at (T-0077); at fire_at they are fired. A shift is settled once, after its window, from all the minutes worked in it. Cash (T-0064): with less than pocket_money cents in the pocket (and enough in the bank) a trip to the ATM is an errand worth cash_errand_score. Work (T-0060, T-0077): people leave for work leave_margin minutes before the walk needs, are sent again every retry_minutes, and the walk is only worked out within look_ahead_hours of a shift; colleagues who worked the same day change their relationship by colleague_deltas after each shift; once a shift they have lunch at work (hunger + lunch_hunger, a meal): after lunch_after_minutes of work, or sooner when hunger falls below needs.json home.eat_below. gentle_profile: the need rates every job uses while the world's gentle work setting is on (the pre-T-0077 shared profile, without hunger). The week (T-0062): on Monday at week.benefit_hour, registered unemployed people under retirement age get benefit_week plus their rent share up to housing_cap, and retired people get pension_week; at week.rent_hour each household member pays an equal share of the home's rent and bills_week from the bank.
